title: verify: test suite with independent oracles
description:
Test suite for both verifiers using oracles independent of the code under test.

What: crates/verify/tests/

X-Usenet-IPFS-Sig tests (oracle: ed25519-dalek sign/verify directly):
1. pass: construct raw article bytes; sign with known ed25519 keypair via dalek; prepend header; verify_usenet_sig → Pass + correct key_id
2. tampered_body: same but flip one byte in body after signing → Fail
3. tampered_header: change Subject: after signing → Fail
4. absent_header: raw message with no X-Usenet-IPFS-Sig → NoKey
5. malformed_sig_field: header present but sig= is not valid base64 → NoKey (not panic)
6. seen_keys_populated: after pass, query store.get_key(key_id) → SeenKey with key_data matching pubkey bytes
7. article_count_increments: verify same key twice → seen_keys.article_count = 2

DKIM tests (oracle: RFC 6376 Appendix A test vectors — exact message and signature from spec):
8. rfc6376_appendix_a: use the exact test message, private key, and expected signature from RFC 6376 §Appendix A; verify → Pass
9. body_tampered: modify one body byte in the RFC test message → Fail
10. dns_error: use a Resolver that returns SERVFAIL for all queries → DnsError recorded, no panic
11. no_dkim_header: plain message with no DKIM-Signature → NoKey
12. key_snapshotted_on_fail: tampered-body case still populates seen_keys with the key from DNS

All tests use in-memory SQLite pool (same pattern as existing tests).
